name: sliver-session-continuity
description: Restore bounded local session evidence after Codex context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Locally retain recent prompts for compaction recovery
interface.longDescription: Stores up to four best-effort-redacted recent prompts, the latest plan, and the last assistant checkpoint in Codex-managed PLUGIN_DATA. It makes no network request; cleanup after abnormal termination is lazy rather than scheduled.
defaultPrompt: Show whether session continuity protection is active.
Explain what local continuity data is stored and how it is cleaned.
